arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Mr. Boas argued the Court should view the statute as a whole.
He contended focusing on two words ignores the regulatory scheme.
Ms. Millett addressed the meaning of the word any in the statute.
She noted Congress stopped funding an administrative mechanism in 1992.

sections.heading: What this case is about
paragraphs: This case tests the scope of a federal firearms statute. The phrase any court appears in the law. the sides that brought the case claim this phrase excludes federal courts. The government claims it includes federal courts. The Court must interpret the statutory text.
